walk_forward_options.split_mode_rule: The first outer out-of-sample instant in the dataset's source timezone, optionally prefixed walk_forward_. It must lie strictly inside walk_forward.start and end_exclusive; there is no release default to fall back on.

train_window.rule: Requested-spec v2 only. A whole number of days (D) or hours (h) passed to the engine as WalkForwardConfig.train_window; required for rolling, refused for expanding. Preflight never infers one.

if mode == "rolling" and self.train_window is None:

temporal_guards.rule: Requested-spec v2 only. Bars removed from the train tail (label horizon, purge) before each OOS start, and bars skipped after each OOS fold (embargo). The engine builds the fold plan; preflight publishes each guarded span.

inner_folds.rule: Requested-spec v2 only, and only for mode_1_decay with per_fold_causal: nested folds inside each outer IS window so decay selection never sees that fold's OOS. Preflight asks the engine to build them and refuses when a fold has too few.

raise ValueError("window_mode must be expanding or rolling")

sweep_dimension_ceiling.basis: Spec 02 §8/§26: at most 8 swept dimensions per run; pinned and fixed parameters do not count. A Portal release policy, not an engine limit.

outer_fold_ceiling.basis: One fold plan is persisted as a bounded metadata document; a longer plan is refused rather than truncated.

estimated_cpu_seconds_ceiling.basis: Declared evaluations (folds × trials × seeds) are estimated before a snapshot is sealed; above this the preflight refuses. P10/P06 reserve real resources separately.
